title: [moved from objectstack-ai/objectstack#16695] `record:details` enumerated `fields:` renders raw key names (`OUR_ENTITY`, `TERM_MONTHS`) instead of the object's declared labels
body:
**Provenance** — rebuilt from `objectstack-ai/objectstack#16695` by the objectstack triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`). The source card is closed as **moved**; its thread carries the full measurement history and ⛔ is not duplicated here. Every bare `#N` from the source has been rewritten to its full name below, per the cross-repo rebuild rule.

⚠️ **This card is the SECOND of two findings on the source card.** The first — the `sections[].group` reference form crashing the renderer — is **recorded closed on evidence** there and ⛔ is not re-opened here.

## The finding

On a `record:details` page, an **enumerated** `fields:` section renders the raw field keys (`OUR_ENTITY`, `TERM_MONTHS`) instead of the object's declared labels, on a tree with **no translation bundle**.

⛔ Untouched by the `group` work that closed finding 1: the two forms take different paths, and the enumerated form was never part of that fix.

## Why it lands here and not in objectstack

The original triage that scoped the source card (`objectstack-ai/objectstack#16695`, comment `5578465065`) already placed **both** findings' fix surface in this repo's `packages/plugin-detail`, and kept a spec-side half in objectstack only on the strength of finding 1's falsified docblock. That strength is gone:

- the shipped behaviour at the pinned commit is 「renders nothing **and reports**」 — the dangling reference IS reported, as `page-section-group-unknown`; the reporting rule is real and named, at `packages/lint/src/validate-page-field-bindings.ts:76` in objectstack (`PAGE_SECTION_GROUP_UNKNOWN`);
- so the spec docblock that predicted 「the reference could never resolve and the section would render nothing with nothing reported」 is wrong only in the **milder** direction, and it lives in a file objectstack does not ship (its package `files` array publishes `src/**/*.zod.ts`, and that file is not one). ⇒ it fails the filing bar for a published-contract defect and is a free correction for whoever next edits it, ⛔ not a deliverable.

⇒ take objectstack out of the remaining finding and it still stands, which is the rule for where a card lives.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT ask for

The original filer asked that finding 2 **not** be closed if the enumerated form resolves labels correctly somewhere else. ⛔ Nothing here proposes closing it. The first act for whoever takes it is to establish where the enumerated form resolves labels today, and whether the raw-key render is specific to the no-translation-bundle case.

## Filing gate

Class ① — a reproducible defect with a named landing surface in this repo. Dedupe: the objectstack source card and its thread are the only prior record; ⚠️ this seat did **not** search this repository's own closed set for a twin, and whoever grades it here should.
